_comment: OpenClaw MCP server config. Most OpenClaw skills wrap an MCP server; this registers mneme directly. Build first: `cargo build -p mneme-mcp --release`. The key is typically `mcpServers` (check your OpenClaw version). Share MNEME_DATA across agents/users only if they should share memory; otherwise pass a per-user `tenant` on each tool call (mneme's scope boundary).
